sentences.en: It is probable that he will win the speech contest.
sentences.zh: 他很可能赢得演讲比赛。

sentences.en: It was such a boring speech that I fell asleep.
sentences.zh: 那场演讲太无聊了，我都睡着了。

sentences.en: The speech of the scholar is well worth listening to.

senses.zh: 演说，演讲，发言,说话，谈话，说话能力或方式,（乐器的）音，音色,方言，民族语言
